subject: Scheduling: global product demo — timezone coverage and holiday conflicts
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@nexthealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@stellarnet.in>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: global product demo — timezone coverage and holiday conflicts

Hi Samantha and Rajiv,

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood — excited to walk the NextHealth team through the platform next month. To make sure we get everyone live, I put together two options that try to respect APAC / EU / US availability. Please see the attached agenda and a proposed .ics with several slot options.

Quick notes:
- We want to avoid scheduling during obvious regional blackout windows (Diwali week for India, Golden Week in Japan, and major EU bank-holiday weekends around Easter).
- If folks prefer, we can do a split demo (short APAC-focused session + a repeat for EU/US) so subject-matter experts can attend the portion most relevant to them.

Proposed slots (all shown local to host):
- Option A: Single session — 2026-11-02 at 08:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 00:00 JST (next day)
- Option B: Split — APAC session 2026-11-03 07:30 PT / 15:30 CET / 23:30 JST (short, hands-on) and US/EU recap 2026-11-04 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST

Attachments: agenda_v2.pdf, proposed_time_slots.ics

If you can share blackout dates for your team, I’ll lock a time.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@stellarnet.in>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Samantha Park <samantha@nexthealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 03:10:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Scheduling: global product demo — timezone coverage and holiday conflicts

Thanks, Jonas — good options. A couple of constraints from our side:

- Diwali week (we expect several engineers to be OOO) is Oct 29 — Nov 2 for many of our India team this year, so Option A falls right in that blackout.
- Naoko from Kyutech is copied here; she also flagged Golden Week planning on their roadmap management side (they’ll be partially offline for early-May planning). Not a conflict for this November demo, but it’ll matter for any follow-ups in H1.

If we must pick next week, I’d prefer the split approach (Option B) — gives our APAC engineers a chance to be present for the hands-on portion without dragging EU/US folks into a late-night session. Can your team staff the APAC session with an engineer who can do a rapid Q&A?

Also, can we get a short compliance pack (SOC 2 summary + brief data-retention note) ahead of the demo so our security folks can triage?

Best,
Rajiv
Rajiv Menon
Director, Integrations — StellarNet

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Scheduling: global product demo — timezone coverage and holiday conflicts

Appreciate the heads-up, Rajiv. We can absolutely staff a small APAC hands-on session — I’ll assign Vivek (technical SE) to lead the APAC shift and I’ll be on the EU/US recap.

Proposed refined plan:
- APAC hands-on: 2026-11-03 23:30 JST / 07:30 PT (90 minutes) — Vivek + 1 engineer from our side for live troubleshooting.
- EU/US recap + Q&A: 2026-11-04 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET (60 minutes) — Jonas + Mina.
- We’ll record the APAC session and post the recording before the EU/US recap so you don’t miss any demos.

Compliance pack: Evelyn, can you drop the SOC 2 summary and short data-retention note into this thread? I’ll also add an internal checklist so we’re not repeating prep across sessions.

Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

This plan looks good to me — thanks for accommodating the APAC engineers. A couple of quick asks before we lock invites:

- Please include the hands-on checklist in the APAC invite so participants know what to pre-install.
- Will the recording include the live Q&A (we’d like that for our internal follow-up)?
- We’ll need the SOC 2 summary and a 1-paragraph data-retention note for our security team by EOD Wednesday so they can start triage.

If those are doable, go ahead and send calendar invites for the two slots. Prefer that any files (SOC 2 summary, checklist) are sent as attachments rather than links.

Thanks,
